'''Pokémon Diamond and Pearl''' (Italian: '''Pokémon Diamante e Perla''') is the opening theme song for the {{pmin|Italy|Italian-language}} dub of the [[S10|tenth season]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} as distributed by Mediaset. It was used from [[DP001]] to [[DP052]].

The opening animation featured footage from the tenth English opening, {{so|Diamond and Pearl}}, and clips from various episodes of the season.

==Trivia==
* This is the last Italian opening theme:
** to not be translated from an English theme.
** to be sung by [[Giorgio Vanni]] and [[Cristina D'Avena]].
** to be officially released on audio streaming platforms until {{DL|List of Italian Pokémon themes|Divento me}} from {{aniseries|HZ}}.
* This is the only Italian-exclusive theme song whose lyrics were not written by Alessandra Valeri Manera.
* With the exception of the logo animation at the start, which was removed, all the footage from its English counterpart was kept and left arranged in its original order. The second half of the opening was therefore composed exclusively of clips from various episodes, along with a different logo animation.
